'''Nebit''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Chief/Legends|Chief]]. He was his [[Nebit's tribe/Legends|tribe's]] main negotiator, and a leader responsible for organizing raids on rival tribes.

==Biography==
[[File:Nebit.png|thumb|left|180px|Nebit dealing with [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]].]]

Nebit's tribe captured droids for trading, and his sandcrawler boasted a large stock of varied makes and models at the time they carried the droids [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who were fugitives from the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]]. His tribe sold the droid [[Counterpart/Legends|counterparts]] to [[Owen Lars/Legends|Owen Lars]], the uncle of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], future [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] hero and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]].<ref name="Episode IV" /> While negotiating with Lars, Nebit adopted a Jawa "business dialect".

Nebit and his tribe later suffered the destruction dealt out on his [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]] by Imperial [[Desert stormtrooper/Legends|sandtroopers]], when the fugitives C-3PO and R2-D2 were traced there. Most of Nebit's tribe were murdered in this event. Nebit died with them.<ref name="Episode IV" />
